snippet.title: Pocket Nook | Game Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Build your dream nook — one pixel at a time!

Ever wished you could turn a tiny room into a perfect little hideaway?
In Pocket Nook, you design charming spaces in cozy pixel art — shifting the layout, placing furniture, and keeping everything neat and clean!

Don't forget to follow us on 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/RedDeer_Games
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/RedDeerGames
and Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reddeer_games/
